scripts.watch:apps: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix app1 run start" "npm --prefix app2 run start"
scripts.build: npm --prefix app1 run build && npm --prefix app2 run build
scripts.serve: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix app1 run serve" "npm --prefix app2 run serve"
scripts.clean: npm --prefix app1 run clean && npm --prefix app2 run clean
